thread:
pagerduty-bot: 🔔 PagerDuty: HIGH - service: backend-api | symptom: 5xx error-rate spike | region: eu-west1 | triggered at 1923456789

liz (oncall): acked — taking lead. assigning to @sam. can someone grab quick triage? :hand:

sam: on it. looking at alerts now. Grafana shows 5xx% at 14:02 UTC jumping from ~0.3% to 12% in 3m.

nisha: seeing increased 502/503 from upstream inference-gateway -> model-pool. also seeing queue length spike on gateway pods.

eli: rolling deploy to gateway finished ~13:55 UTC? cc @ben any config changes in last 20m?

ben: I merged a small connection-pool tweak 13:50 (reduced keepalive timeout). didn't expect this. rolling back now if we think it's related.

sam: running quick checks — reproducing 502 at the gateway. hitting one gateway pod:
```
$ curl -I https://gateway-eu-west1.redwood.example/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer x"
HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
Server: nginx
X-Request-Id: 6f9a2b
```

sam: grabbing logs from pod gateway-5c7d: `kubectl -n inference logs gateway-5c7d -c gateway`

sam: log snippet:
```
2026-03-14T14:03:01Z ERROR upstream request failed: connection reset by peer
2026-03-14T14:03:01Z WARN backend-pool: recv timeout after 15s
```

nisha: backend pool shows many ephemeral connections in CLOSE_WAIT, looks like sockets not being reused.

ben: rolling back my PR now (`git revert f3a2b1`) and kicking a new deploy to gateway (will take ~2m).

monitoring-bot: Update: 5xx rate at 11.8% (5m window). p90 latency increased to 2.4s.

liz (oncall): if rollback doesn't land fast, scale gateway replicas to buy time. sam, nisha — can you increase replicas to 12? current is 6.

sam: scaling: `kubectl -n inference scale deploy/gateway --replicas=12` -> in progress.

eli: checking downstream model-pool health — nodes show high CPU on quantized-v1 workers, but not saturated. no OOMs.

sam: rollback triggered, new rollout started (deployment gateway) -> sha f3a2b1 reverted. watching rollout.

nisha: adding temporary circuit-breaker rule in envoy to fail fast for model-pool when latency > 5s to avoid pile-up. patching envoy config.

ben: rollback completed; pods restarting.

monitoring-bot: 5xx rate dropped to 6.9% (2m after rollback).

sam: sampling logs after restart — backend connections look healthier, fewer resets. running a quick synthetic load against EU gateway.

sam: synthetic test: 100 requests over 30s -> 2 failures (2%). repeating to confirm.

liz (oncall): good. start notifying customer-impact folks. need assessment: which customers impacted and mitigation timeline.

nisha: quick query: last 5m request volume ~120k, error count ~14k. top affected API key: acct-42 (20% of failing requests). likely heavy retriever load from them.

ben: I can reach out to acct-42 directly if we need to throttle them temporarily. recommend not doing that yet; prefer to stabilize infra first.

eli: recommending follow-up actions: (1) revert change permanently from gateway config, (2) review connection pooling defaults, (3) design grace period for keepalive changes.

liz (oncall): agreed. set severity -> P1 but mark customer-impact limited (subset of large requests). timeline: mitigation in place, continue monitoring for 30m, will update PD when resolved.

monitoring-bot: 5xx rate at 2.1% (14:12 UTC).

sam: running `kubectl get pods -n inference -o wide` — majority of gateway pods are Ready. no CrashLoopBackOff.

sam: one more check: `ss -tanp | grep CLOSE_WAIT` on gateway shows transient but normal.

liz (oncall): handing off to night oncall in 40m. @nisha please run a short blameless RCA draft and add to #postmortems. include timeline + immediate remediation.

nisha: will do. adding runbook steps and links. starting draft now.

ben: pinging acct-42 private channel to say we saw elevated errors earlier, but we've mitigated and are monitoring. will follow up with RCA.

monitoring-bot: Update: 5xx rate <= 0.5% for 10m window.

liz (oncall): thanks team. leaving note: rollback of connection-pool change + short scale up + envoy circuit-breaker bought stability. No longer paging. closing thread after 30m of stability.

sam: suggestion for postmortem action items: add integration test for connection reuse when keepalive changes, add canary traffic profile for gateway config changes, and add a feature-flagged deploy for connection parameters.

nisha: adding action items to postmortem. assigning owners: ben -> config revert + tests, sam -> canary traffic harness, eli -> review model-pool retry behavior.

liz (oncall): final status: incident mitigated, PD incident auto-resolved. next steps: formal RCA in #postmortems and retro tomorrow 9am PT. :white_check_mark:

pagerduty-bot: Incident resolved by liz (oncall) at 1923460355
